title: Holocaust Denier Vincent Reynouard Sentenced to Eight Months in Prison
detail: The Paris criminal court sentenced repeat Holocaust denier Vincent Reynouard to eight months in prison for articles claiming the 'technical impossibility' of gas chambers and for antisemitic insults describing 'the Jew' as a 'pathogenic agent.' It is his eleventh conviction since 2006 for contesting crimes against humanity; the court could not order home confinement because he has no personal residence.

media.caption: Coverage of Vincent Reynouard's sentencing for Holocaust denial.
